title: Kehai video draft (what Claude writes)
description: A short or long video as Claude writes it (write_short, revise, long_video edit). km/drafts.py turns it into an edit.json: ids become file paths, text becomes {"en": ...}, the script becomes `script`. Kept inside the structured-outputs subset: every field required (empty string, 0, "none" or [] for unused), no number ranges (km/drafts.py checks those), no unions. Times are seconds.

id.description: Lowercase words joined by dashes, 3 to 60 characters, e.g. caught-in-the-dark.

title.description: A working title for the owner.

hook.description: The idea of the first two seconds, in a few words (the on-screen hook is a `hook` overlay).

captions.description: words: a few words at a time, the spoken one lit; lines: whole lines.

name.description: A few words for the owner, e.g. 'the catch from above'.

transition.description: Into this scene from the one before (ignored on the first). Anything but cut overlaps the two scenes by 0.4 s.

source.description: shot or split: a shot id; image: an image asset id; colour: ''.

trim.description: Seconds skipped at the start of the source shot (0 if none).

speed.description: [] plays at 1x. One key: that rate throughout. Several: a smooth ramp through them. Rates 0.1 to 8.

zoom.description: [] for none. The frame eases from key to key: zooms and pans.

label.description: A small tag on the shot (in a split, which side is which); '' for none.

second_source.description: split: the second shot id; otherwise ''.

second_trim.description: split: seconds skipped at the start of the second shot; otherwise 0.

second_label.description: split: the second shot's tag; otherwise ''.

split.description: split: row is side by side, column is one above the other; otherwise none.

colour.description: colour: the flat background; otherwise none.

game_volume.description: The game's own sound in the shot, 0 to 1.5 (0.7 usual; it dips under the voice by itself).

x.description: The point zoomed into, across the frame: 0 left, 1 right.

source.description: A shot id shown small in a corner (her mind alone, or a second camera); '' for none.

size.description: Width as a fraction of the frame's, 0.15 to 0.7.

label.description: A tag on it, '' for none.

from.description: Seconds into the scene it appears.

to.description: Seconds into the scene it goes; 0 for the end of the scene.
Seconds into the scene; 0 for the end of the scene.

target.description: arrow and circle on a shot scene: who they point at. The code places them where the shot's track has that body at that moment (an arrow's x, y is then where it starts, or 0, 0 to let the code choose). Otherwise none.

text.description: hook and label: the text; lower-third: the title; meme: the line (pov, caption-bar, nobody: her answer; top-bottom: the top; expectation-reality: the first half's tag); otherwise ''. *Stars* make words crimson.

text2.description: lower-third: the subtitle; meme top-bottom: the bottom; meme expectation-reality: the second half's tag; otherwise ''.

asset.description: image, gif, lottie: the asset id; otherwise ''.

x.description: 0 to 1 across. label: its centre; circle: its centre; image/gif/lottie: its centre; arrow: where it starts.

x2.description: arrow: where it points, across; otherwise 0.

y2.description: arrow: where it points, down; otherwise 0.

size.description: circle: radius as a fraction of the width (0.03 to 0.5); image/gif/lottie: width fraction (0.05 to 1); label: 0.7 small, 1 medium, 1.4 large; otherwise 1.

style.description: label: its colour (crimson, ink or paper); arrow and circle: their colour; otherwise crimson.

at.description: Seconds into the whole video when the line starts.

text.description: What is said, in English, written to be spoken.

asset.description: A music asset id, or '' for none.

offset.description: Seconds into the track to start from.

volume.description: 0 to 1; 0.35 usual (it ducks under the voice by itself).

duration.description: Seconds, 2 to 4 for a short, up to 15 for a long video.

cta.description: The call to action, e.g. 'Follow for the next shift'.
